host_storage_type: NVMe SSD (instance-local, compile caches); NFS shared filesystem (dataset)
host_networking: 8x AMD Pensando Pollara 400 AI NIC (ionic) per node, 400 Gb/s each, RoCE v2
host_networking_topology: RoCE v2 Ethernet, 8x 400 Gb/s per node, one NIC per GPU (8 rails)
host_memory_configuration: DDR5, 2.7 TiB presented to the VM
accelerator_interconnect_topology: intra-node fully connected Infinity Fabric; inter-node RoCE with GPU-direct RDMA
cooling: Direct liquid cooling (GPUs at the MI355X's 1400 W socket power limit)
hw_notes: Cloud virtual machines (KVM): each node's 8 GPUs and 8 AI NICs are passed through to the VM; the VM presents 2 sockets x 59 cores x 2 threads of the 64-core EPYC 9575F.
framework: Primus (Megatron-LM backend) with Primus-Turbo and aiter; PyTorch from rocm/primus:v26.7
sw_notes: Transformer linear layers: forward GEMMs in MXFP6 (OCP E2M3, E8M0 scale per 32 elements, 32-point Hadamard on both GEMM operands) except the joint blocks' text stream (MLP and attention out-projection) in MXFP4 (OCP E2M1); backward GEMMs (dgrad, wgrad) in MXFP4, rounded to nearest. Attention, normalisation and communication in bf16.
